overview: This file documents U.S. policy making on civil aviation in occupied Japan from 1945 to 1949. Correspondence, draft policies, and interagency decisions address airline licensing, foreign routes, domestic service, cabotage, security, and airfields. A preliminary research report and statistical tables provide evidence on prewar Japanese aviation and its possible postwar needs.
interest: Drafts and correspondence reveal policy disputes; prewar traffic and production figures show the evidence officials used.
